title: Agentic Product Requirements: A 10-Part Framework for Defining AI Agent Behavior
description: The PM follow-up in the agentic AI series: a 10-part requirements framework covering user goals, agent responsibility, autonomy levels, tool permissions, statistical success criteria, failure behavior, deterministic guardrails, evaluation scenarios, human escalation, and release criteria as eval gates.
author: Chris Lau

title: The SDLC Skill Stack Is Getting Larger: How Agentic AI Expands Every Engineering Role
description: A follow-up to how agentic AI rewrites the SDLC: why traditional roles don't disappear but expand—engineers constrain non-determinism, QA adopts evals, SRE observes agent behavior, architects govern autonomy, security covers prompt injection, and PMs define behavior over functionality.
author: Chris Lau

title: From Deterministic to Probabilistic: How Agentic AI Rewrites the SDLC
description: How familiar engineering practices translate to agentic AI: trajectory evals replace unit tests, multi-hop tracing replaces logs, memory tiers replace classic state, eval gates replace CI/CD, and execution limits become the new resiliency.
author: Chris Lau

title: Demystifying Relational Database Integration: Lessons Learned from SQLite Local Development to Aiven PostgreSQL Production
description: An architectural deep-dive into integrating relational databases into FastAPI: dual SQLite/PostgreSQL setups, URI scheme normalization, Alembic migrations, seeding, and resilient JSON fallbacks.
author: Chris Lau

title: Demystifying Full-Stack Operational Monitoring & Telemetry: Zero-Cost Observability from Browser RUM to FastAPI Middleware
description: An architectural deep-dive into full-stack observability without expensive SaaS tools: UUID request correlation, structured JSON access logging, health readiness probes, browser RUM, and synthetic E2E diagnostics.
author: Chris Lau

title: Building a Live GitHub Activity Dashboard: A Step-by-Step Architectural Deep Dive
description: A comprehensive step-by-step engineering breakdown of integrating a real-time GitHub activity feed into a React portfolio—covering schema transformation, 15-min sessionStorage caching, custom hooks, Storybook stories, and multi-tier testing.
author: Chris Lau

title: A Backend TPM's Journey to Modern Frontend: Building a Production React & TypeScript Portfolio
description: Reflections and core architectural lessons learned by a backend TPM building a production-ready React application — from three novelty themes to a consolidated Light Crisp design system — to gain hands-on technical domain depth.
author: Chris Lau

title: Building a Full-Featured Blog Engine in React & TypeScript: Architecture, Search, and Multi-Tier Testing
description: A comprehensive, developer-friendly guide on how we designed, implemented, and tested a production-ready blog system in our React & TypeScript portfolio website.
author: Chris Lau
